self_report.deviations: No departure from the point rules. Method notes: (1) edge points (left, right, upper, lower) were taken as the integer pixel nearest the anti-aliased boundary estimated from grey values; I settled this after image 5 and re-recorded the edge points of images 1-4 the same way (changes of 1 px). For dark sensor slots at the body top, the edge was taken as the first pixel not mostly background. (2) Where the top or bottom of the body is a flat segment, the x of upper/lower is the middle of that segment. (3) Hub centres were estimated from the cap outline (left/right and top/bottom dark rings, circle fit where the lower edge is shadowed); several sit within about 1 px of a half-pixel and were rounded. (4) Embedded dark sensor windows flush with the body outline were treated as part of the body (e.g. 53bffc4f651b1baa lower).
